findings.title: Ledgerly trails Cashvane in AI answers
findings.text: Ledgerly appears in 40.3% of AI answers, ranging from 39.2% to 42.5% across runs. Cashvane appears in 61.8%, which shows clear room to grow.

findings.title: Comparison questions are the fastest area to win
findings.text: In comparison questions, Ledgerly appears in 10.4% of answers, while Cashvane appears in 77.1%.

findings.title: Third-party sources shape the answers
findings.text: AI answers cite softwarecompare.example in 50.4% of answers. Ledgerly's own site is cited in 9.3% of answers.

quick_wins.title: Build a comparison hub
quick_wins.text: Publish honest comparison pages that place Ledgerly next to Cashvane and other options, with clear criteria and short summaries AI answers can quote.

quick_wins.title: Answer the gap questions directly
quick_wins.text: Create a page that answers "Are cloud treasury tools better than bank portals?" in its first paragraph, followed by a plain comparison table.

quick_wins.title: Earn coverage on softwarecompare.example
quick_wins.text: Pitch softwarecompare.example with product updates and customer data, so the sources AI engines already trust include Ledgerly.
